messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

A reminder that 4.5 hours remain unposted against your matters for the week ending 26 September. Please complete your time entries by 5pm Friday so we can finalise the month-end WIP report. Matters with narratives missing are listed in the attached summary.

Thanks,
Accounts | Whitfield Carter LLP
